These are different rates for the same country (China). However, Claim 1 specifies a specific product (windshield wiper) and date (May 3), while Claim 2 gives a general rate (34%) announced April 2. The dates might differ (Jan imposition vs April announcement). Claim 1 says "starting on May 3". Claim 2 doesn't specify effective date for the 34% but implies current status at announcement (April 2). Claim 2 says "China will be subject to a 34 percent levy". This looks like a conflict on the rate for China goods.
